deliverables: WP1: Plutarch and Ply Maintenance, Compatibility & Developer Experience
Critical breakages and serious vulnerabilities response
Bug fixes, correctness improvements, and optimizations
Documentation, examples, technical blog posts, and developer-experience improvements
request.recipient: Intersect treasury management smart contract stake address for project funding on behalf of MLabs/vendor
request.what: Annual funding for maintenance and enhancement of Plutarch and Ply, including compatibility, bug fixes, optimizations, documentation, examples, technical blog posts, and developer-experience improvements.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 1,162,746 ADA, consisting of 1,128,880 ADA for Plutarch and Ply maintenance and 33,866 ADA for the Intersect Budget Administration fee.

Plutarch is described as a Haskell eDSL for creating efficient Cardano smart contracts via controlled compilation into UPLC, and Ply is described as tooling for serializing Plutarch scripts to and from CIP-57 blueprint-style artifacts with inferred types.

MLabs states that Plutarch and Ply have been extensively used across the Cardano ecosystem, citing an internal audit count of at least 26 teams in the motivation and at least 15 teams in the rationale.
MLabs states that Plutarch scripts rank among the smallest in its public cross-language benchmark suite while requiring comparatively low on-chain compute and memory.
The proposal says the next funding period may include protocol-era compatibility for major ledger updates such as the Dijkstra era if relevant changes land during the funding period.

The proposal states that if Plutarch and Ply fall behind Cardano ledger and Plutus/UPLC evolution, existing adopters could face more friction, migration risk, bespoke workarounds, or avoidable rewrites.

The proposal states that it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain Treasury Withdrawal submission under the approved framework.
The proposal states that the requested amount does not breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the time of submission, either alone or in aggregate.
The proposal discloses prior MLabs funding through treasury actions, Project Catalyst Fund9 and Fund13, and a prior 70,000 ADA Intersect payment for Conway-era Plutarch updates.

The proposal states that funds will be administered through Intersect-managed Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with multisignature-style admin, leadership, and external oversight roles plus a public dashboard for auditability.

summary: The document requests 1,162,746 ADA for MLabs Plutarch and Ply maintenance and enhancement, presents the tools as established Cardano smart contract infrastructure, cites benchmark and governance-process references, discloses prior funding, and describes Intersect-managed smart-contract disbursement controls.
